messages:
maya: Heads-up: saw failed mTLS handshakes between services in ap-south -> eu-west after the RBAC tighten this morning. Anyone else?
jon: Yup. Proxy logs show: 
```
2025-03-04T11:17:20Z warn mtls handshake failed peer=10.4.2.6 err="x509: certificate signed by unknown authority"
```
ops-oncall: Correlated KMS logs show decrypt denies at 11:17:22 for the prod-wrap key: `Decrypt Deny principal=svc-proxy-eu-west reason=iam.permission.denied`. We already diverted traffic.
luis: If KMS unwraps were denied, the proxy wouldn't have a private key to present -> empty client certs. Can we check rotator timing?
jon: Rotator wrote bundle at 11:17:00, RBAC deny applied at 11:17:18. ~18s window where readers got revoked after write.
maya: Ordering issue. Short-term mitigation: restore keystore-read for svc-proxy, replay the bundle, and revert RBAC change.
ops-oncall: Revert PR opened and deployed: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/6221. Replayed bundle to eu-west. Handshake errors dropped within 90s.
security-bot: Alert: RBAC change PR matched previous keystore ordering incident pattern. 8 KMS denies logged.
luis: Long-term fixes proposed: 1) implement write+ack for rotator (rotator tags bundle version; readers ack when they load it), 2) orchestration preflight that runs keystore-read checks and KMS decrypt smoke tests from impacted principals before flipping denies, 3) stream IAM deny details to BigQuery for faster triage.
jon: Also add CI gating for RBAC changes that touch keystore/KMS principals to run the preflight in staging. And add alerting: >5 KMS decrypt denies for a principal in 1m pages security oncall.
maya: Assignments: maya -> revert PR and incident note; luis -> RFC for write+ack + audit export; jon -> reconciler + CI gate; ops-oncall -> update runbook + fallback path for cross-region TLS.
ops-oncall: Added runbook entry under incidents/keystore-ordering. Keystore replay recorded by keystore-bot at 11:19:05.
maya: Logging thread for RCA. We'll include timeline and proposed gating in the postmortem. :white_check_mark:
